Di easy, recovery & long run, patokannya: For easy, recovery & long runs, HR is the guide. Jakarta is hot; if HR climbs, slow down.
Warm up & cool down sudah termasuk total: Warm-up & cool-down are included in the total km. Dynamic stretching is outside the program.
Libur & cuti bersama di hari lari dikoso: Holidays & collective leave on run days are left open — fill them yourself if you like. Weekends still train.
Senin lower, Rabu upper, Jumat shoulder: Monday lower, Wednesday upper, Friday shoulder & core. Menus A/B alternate weekly; set counts follow the phase. Because Monday is leg day, Tuesday is always easy.
Deload. Lari setelah tarawih atau ngabub: Deload. Run after tarawih or a short run before iftar. No hard sessions while fasting.
Long run panjang di blok Peak dimulai se: Long runs in the Peak block start before Subuh — get used to the stop–restart rhythm of race day.
≥ 18 km: gel/karbo tiap ± 45 menit. Mula: ≥ 18 km: gel/carbs every ± 45 minutes. From B07: simulate aid stations every 2.5–3 km like JRF.
Butuh 6:24/km selama 42 km. Kalau HM TT: It needs 6:24/km for 42 km. If the week-13 HM TT is > 2:12, lower the target to 4:40–4:45.
